description: Without siteId: a read-only three-check probe of any public URL (favicon, canonical self-reference with hreflang x-default, BreadcrumbList). With siteId: run that site's full applicable rule set on this one page and diff every rule against the site's most recent completed audit run, reporting fixed / regressed / still failing — use this after you change a page. Read-only on both paths: it never writes an audit run or flips finding state, so a full audit is still what commits a resolution. Requires the audit:read scope.

rules.description: Optional rule ids to check (default: every rule that applies to this page). Rule ids that do not apply are reported in notApplicable.

siteId.description: Optional. Scope the check to a site you can read: uses its rule set and compares against its latest completed run. The URL must belong to that site's domain.

name: audit_url
title: Check one URL, or verify a fix against the last audit
